Class ConnectionManager

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.service.ConnectionManager
public final class ConnectionManager extends Object
Singleton manager for transport connections and protocol runtime adapters.

Owns the lifecycle of TCP, Serial, and BLE connections: stores connection profiles (ConnectionEntry) in ~/.meshapp/connections.json, creates and closes transports, selects the communication protocol, and starts the matching runtime. For the existing UI, it still exposes Meshtastic DeviceState and ProtocolHandler.

Each connection is identified by the string id from ConnectionEntry.

    • getInstance

      public static ConnectionManager getInstance()
      Returns the singleton connection manager. On first call, loads profiles from ~/.meshapp/connections.json.

    • load

      public void load()
      Loads saved connection profiles from ~/.meshapp/connections.json.

      Runtime fields such as connected and reconnecting are not stored in the file and are set only while the application is running.

    • updateEntry

      public void updateEntry(ConnectionEntry updated)
      Updates saved parameters of an existing connection profile. Active and reconnecting profiles are left unchanged so transport parameters are not modified underneath an already open runtime.
      Parameters:
      updated - profile with the same id and new parameters

    • removeEntry

      public void removeEntry(String id)
      Deletes a connection profile. Disconnects it first if it is active, then saves JSON and notifies listeners.
      Parameters:
      id - profile id

    • connect

      public void connect(String id) throws ConnectionException
      Opens a connection by profile id.

      The method creates a transport (TCP, Serial, or BLE), opens it, selects a protocol adapter from ProtocolRegistry, creates ProtocolRuntime, and starts the initial protocol synchronization. If the same id is already active or currently connecting, the call is ignored.

      Parameters:
      id - connection profile id
      Throws:
      ConnectionException - if the profile is missing or connection fails

    • connectAutoconnectEntries

      public void connectAutoconnectEntries()
      Starts background connections for profiles with auto-connect enabled. Idempotent for the current manager instance and intended to be called once during application startup.

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect(String id)
      Disconnects and clears associated resources such as DeviceState, ProtocolHandler, and config future.
      Parameters:
      id - connection profile id

    • disconnectForDeviceReboot

      public boolean disconnectForDeviceReboot(String id)
      Disconnects as an expected part of a device reboot/restart cycle.

      Unlike disconnect(String), this is not treated as a user disconnect: the transport is released, but auto-reconnect remains allowed. This is needed after saving configuration, when the radio reboots itself and the BLE/TCP/Serial session becomes stale.

      Parameters:
      id - connection profile id

    • disconnectForDeviceReboot

      public boolean disconnectForDeviceReboot(String id, long expectedConnectionGeneration)
      Disconnects for reboot only if this is still the same transport session seen by the caller. This protects against a late save handoff that could otherwise disconnect a fresh connection after an independent reconnect.

    • disconnectForDeviceRebootFromRuntime

      public boolean disconnectForDeviceRebootFromRuntime(String id, ProtocolRuntime<?> expectedRuntime)
      Disconnects for reboot only if the signal came from the current runtime. This protects a fresh reconnection from late FromRadio.REBOOTED events emitted by an already closed protocol session.

    • expectDeviceReboot

      public void expectDeviceReboot(String id)
      Marks the next connection drop as an expected device reboot. Needed when firmware can close the transport by itself before the UI calls disconnectForDeviceReboot(String).
